arguments.message: shaft power above what the pod reserve can hold to the finish

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < sustainable_shaft_power_w * 0.92 and elapsed_s > 600 and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: shaft power well below sustainable: reserve going unused
boat slower than pod power predicts beyond the fitted current: rudder snag, drag, or local current
shaft power near zero: pod failure or paddler stopped
pod reserve below 25 percent with more than 1.5 km left
1500 m to go: plan the finish

arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m. CP boat 95 W, shaft 158 W (test may be 10-25 pct off). Start hard is normal; expect settle by min 3-4. Pace off the POD (shaft power vs sustainable_shaft_power_w), not boat-speed numbers, which blame current/drag on the paddler. Watches set: too_hard_pod, too_easy_pod, drag_gap (push_local minus push_along below -0.25 for 40 s = possible rudder snag: check heading/turn before clear_rudder), pod_low (pod fail), reserve_low, final_1500. Finish: aim to empty pod reserve over last ~1 km. Leg 1 heads north into about -0.2 m/s current.

text: no cue: start effort above CP is expected in the first minutes; watches and plan set to catch overpacing, drag, pod faults and the finish.

arguments.text: Settle a touch now. Long smooth strokes, save it for later.

Min 4.3: still above CP after start (shaft 167 vs sustainable 160, pod reserve 57 pct, boat model reserve 44 pct). Paddler says 7/10, really hurting. Cued ease (no pace target, current reverses each leg). Check at next wake-up that shaft settles near 155-160 W and does not drop below ~150.

text: Cued a gentle ease: still above critical power at minute 4 with the reserve draining and the paddler hurting.

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease right back to steady, let the current carry you.

Min 7, leg 2 (south, current helps ~+0.2 to +0.3). After first ease cue shaft dipped to 164 then crept back to 175 after the turn (sustainable 160). Pod reserve 44 pct. Cued ease again. Boat-model reserve (21 pct) drains faster than pod: fitted current likely under-reads help on this leg (push_local 0.30 vs push_along 0.21), so trust POD reserve. Paddler tends to creep up: may need a hold cue once settled near 158-160 W.

text: Cued ease: shaft power crept back to 175 W against 160 W sustainable, pod reserve 44 pct with 8.8 km left.

arguments.text: Back off now and recover. Plenty of race left, settle in.

arguments.message: turned north into current: reset the pace target from 160 (set for the downstream leg)

arguments.text: Min 8.6: paddler says cooked, cannot hold this. Shaft still 171 (sustainable 159), pod reserve 35 pct, boat reserve 1 pct; no fade yet. Two plain ease cues barely moved power. Cued ease with pace 160 s/500 over ground (fits the downstream leg 2 only, aim shaft ~150). MUST reset after the turn north (watch turn_north_once): into -0.2 current a 160 pace is far too hard; about 180-185 over ground fits shaft ~155. If paddler keeps hurting at CP, consider lowering cp_shaft to ~150.

text: Cued ease to 160 s/500 over ground: paddler says cooked, still 8 pct above critical power; watch set to reset pace after the next turn.

arguments.text: Forget the pace now. This effort is right, hold it steady.

Min 11.6, leg 3 north: ease worked, shaft 150-155 since min 9.7 (below CP 158), pod reserve refilling 33 to 37 pct. Cued hold with no pace (cancels the 160 target). Paddler again 7/10 really hurting (same words as min 4, so weak evidence). Fade -2 to -3 pct = easing at same rate 64, not a collapse. Plan: let shaft sit ~155 for a few min, then hold 158-160; do not push before ~km 7. Turn watch used up; no more pace targets unless re-set per leg.

text: Cued hold without a pace target to cancel the downstream pace on the upstream leg; paddler recovering just below critical power.

arguments.text: Headwind now. Pace slows upwind, effort is perfect, stay smooth.

Min 13: radio says wind filling from the north 8-12 kn = headwind on northbound (odd) legs, tailwind southbound. push_local now -0.29 on leg 3 (was -0.18 on leg 1). Boat-speed numbers (reserve_left_pct, pace_gap) will mislead while push_along lags; drag_gap watch may false-alarm after turns. Shaft 158 = CP, pod reserve 36 pct. Cued reassure (do not chase pace upwind). Option later: slightly more effort upwind, slightly less downwind, if reserve allows.

text: Cued reassure about the new headwind so the paddler holds effort at critical power rather than chasing the slower pace.

arguments.text: Do not fight the wind. Ease back to steady effort now.

Min 15.5, leg 3 upwind: shaft jumped 158 to 188 W while boat slowed; push_local fell gradually to -0.55 (linear ramp, no step, heading steady) = wind building, not a rudder snag. Paddler 8/10 really hurting, so the pod reading is real effort: fighting the headwind. Pod reserve 22 pct, empties in 270 m at that power. Cued ease. Boat-model reserve (rising to 22 pct) is wrong while push_along lags the wind; ignore it. Upwind legs will tempt overpushing: watch for it each northbound leg.

text: Cued ease: paddler fighting the building headwind at 188 W shaft (19 pct over critical power) with the pod reserve at 22 pct and 7.3 km left.

arguments.message: pod reserve under 10 pct with far to go: blow-up risk

arguments.condition: heading_deg > 150 and heading_deg < 210 and push_local_mps < 0.1 and elapsed_s > 1000
arguments.message: southbound (downwind, down-current) but boat still slower than pod power predicts: drag on the boat, maybe rudder snag

arguments.text: Min 15.8: ease cue at 15.7 not yet acted (shaft 196, pod reserve 16 pct). Next cue allowed ~16.7. Added reserve_critical (pod under 10 pct) and downwind_drag_check: if on the southbound leg push_local stays below +0.1 (should be strongly positive with wind and current behind), the slowdown is drag on the boat (rudder snag?) not wind: then consider clear_rudder.

text: no cue: an ease cue went out seconds ago and the cue gate is closed; added watches for a critical reserve and for drag that persists downwind.
no cue: drag alert already diagnosed as the building headwind (see notes); ease cue from 15.7 still taking effect and the cue gate is closed for 40 s.

arguments.message: cue gate open again: paddler ignored the 15.7 ease cue, pod reserve near empty, cue a strong ease now (no pace target, turn south is close)

arguments.text: Min 16.2: ease cue at 15.7 ignored, shaft 199, pod reserve 7.6 pct, 7.2 km left: blow-up imminent. Watch cue_gate_open_1 wakes me at 1001 s to cue a strong ease (no pace target: the turn south is about 200 m away and pace targets carry through turns). Rudder vs wind still open: downwind_drag_check decides after the turn.

text: no cue: gate closed for 25 s; set a wake-up for when it reopens to cue a strong ease, since the paddler ignored the last one and the reserve is nearly empty.

arguments.text: Min 16.8 KEY: POD IS DRIFTING HIGH. Shaft reading rose as a smooth linear ramp 158 to 210 W (about +0.24 W/s, from ~min 14) while GPS speed stayed flat at 2.50-2.52, and paddler says 7/10 (same as at 155 W). Do NOT trust shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local_mps, sustainable_shaft_power_w from now on; removed all pod-based watches. Paddler likely still near CP (true pod reserve maybe ~35 pct). Pace from GPS + boat model (CP 95 W, water pace ~172 = 2.9 m/s) once push_along refits the wind after a turn or two, plus asking the paddler.

text: no cue: pod power is drifting high (flat GPS speed, paddler 7/10), so the paddler is not overcooked; removed pod-based watches and will pace from GPS, the boat model and the paddler.

arguments.text: Tailwind now. Ease a little, let it run, recover here.

arguments.message: about 90 s into downwind leg 4: compare GPS speed and push_local with leg 2 to test pod drift vs real effort

arguments.text: Min 18, leg 4 south (downwind + current). Paddler: this hurts, cannot keep this up. Pod still 200+. Hypotheses: (A) pod drifting high (my lead, GPS flat while pod rose); (B) paddler really at 200 W and empty; (C) CP underestimated. Test on this leg: leg 2 gave GPS 3.26 at pod 170 with current +0.25, no wind. If GPS now only ~3.3-3.4 and push_local well under +0.35, pod is reading high. eta_est fell 0.615 to 0.552 (absorbing the drift). Cued ease downwind (spend less where the boat runs fast, more upwind). Watch downwind_check_1 at 1160 s.

text: Cued a small ease on the downwind leg: the paddler says they cannot keep this up, and easing where the boat runs fast costs least; set a check to test the pod-drift hypothesis.
